import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem congruent_ten_pow_sub_ten_pow_dvd_eleven (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (h : 11 ∣ a - 10) : 11 ∣ a ^ n - 10 ^ n := by
  have h₁ : a ≡ 10 [ZMOD 11] := by
    
    have h₂ : 11 ∣ a - 10 := h
    rw [Int.ModEq]
    
    omega
  
  have h₂ : a ^ n ≡ 10 ^ n [ZMOD 11] := by
    
    exact h₁.pow n
  
  have h₃ : 11 ∣ a ^ n - 10 ^ n := by
    
    rw [Int.ModEq] at h₂
    
    omega
  
  exact h₃

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem congruent_ten_pow_sub_ten_pow_dvd_eleven (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (h : 11 ∣ a - 10) : 11 ∣ a ^ n - 10 ^ n := by
  have h₁ : a % 11 = 10 := by
    have h₂ : 11 ∣ a - 10 := h
    have h₃ : a % 11 = 10 := by
      omega
    exact h₃
  
  have h₂ : ∀ (n : ℕ), 11 ∣ a ^ n - 10 ^ n := by
    intro n
    have h₃ : a % 11 = 10 := h₁
    have h₄ : ∀ (n : ℕ), a ^ n % 11 = 10 ^ n % 11 := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp [h₃, pow_zero, Int.mul_emod, Int.sub_emod]
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
        simp [h₃, ih, Int.mul_emod, Int.sub_emod]
        <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf at * <;> omega
    have h₅ : (a ^ n - 10 ^ n) % 11 = 0 := by
      have h₆ : a ^ n % 11 = 10 ^ n % 11 := h₄ n
      have h₇ : (a ^ n - 10 ^ n) % 11 = 0 := by
        omega
      exact h₇
    have h₆ : 11 ∣ a ^ n - 10 ^ n := by
      omega
    exact h₆
  
  exact h₂ n

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem congruent_ten_pow_sub_ten_pow_dvd_eleven (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (h : 11 ∣ a - 10) : 11 ∣ a ^ n - 10 ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      have hleft : 11 ∣ (a - 10) * a ^ n :=
        dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h _
      have hright : 11 ∣ (a ^ n - 10 ^ n) * 10 :=
        dvd_mul_of_dvd_left ih _
      have hsum :
          11 ∣ (a - 10) * a ^ n + (a ^ n - 10 ^ n) * 10 :=
        dvd_add hleft hright
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
      convert hsum using 1 <;> ring

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem congruent_ten_pow_sub_ten_pow_dvd_eleven (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (h : 11 ∣ a - 10) : 11 ∣ a ^ n - 10 ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      have h₁ : 11 ∣ (a ^ n - 10 ^ n) * a :=
        dvd_mul_of_dvd_left ih a
      have h₂ : 11 ∣ 10 ^ n * (a - 10) :=
        dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h (10 ^ n)
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
      convert dvd_add h₁ h₂ using 1 <;> ring
